title: RepoAssure Design System v2 Adoption v0.1
objective: Vendor RepoAssure Design System v2 into the workspace as a shared package with self-hosted typefaces, so that both the public website and the Project Intelligence Console can consume one token system. This goal makes no visual change to either surface.
acceptance: Design System v2 tokens, base stylesheet, brand assets, and the 37 React primitives are vendored as a workspace package.
Brand typefaces are self-hosted. No stylesheet, component, or generated artifact references an external font CDN.
The website builds, typechecks, and renders unchanged. This goal introduces no visual difference.
The design system package is consumable from both a React surface and a static HTML string generator.
Website build, typecheck, unit tests, and lint pass.
